high_level_description: The image depicts a formal interview or discussion setting. Two individuals are seated on white armchairs with gold legs, positioned across from each other. The person on the left is holding a microphone and appears to be speaking, while the person on the right is listening attentively. The setting includes a modern, minimalist design with a geometric patterned wall in the background. There are two small wooden side tables between the chairs, each adorned with a vase of flowers and a blue water bottle. A small white mug is also placed on one of the side tables.
